paite: Kuapeuh saptuam heutu a pan ut in nasep hoih a-ut ahi, chih adik ahi.
heading: Saptuam Kemtu Heutute
english: This is a faithful saying: someone who seeks to be an overseer desires a good work.

paite: Huchi in saptuam heutu zaw gensiatbei, zi khat nei, kidek thei, navaktak, midiktat, mipahtakdan siam, thuhilh siam,
english: The overseer therefore must be without reproach, the husband of one wife, temperate, sensible, modest, hospitable, good at teaching;

paite: uain khamhat lou, mivuak hat lou, minunnem ahi ding hi, selhat lou, sum deihta lou,
english: not a drinker, not violent, not greedy for money, but gentle, not quarrelsome, not covetous;

paite: zahtakhuaitak a tate kemsiam, amah insung kizentak a vaihawm siammi ahi ding hi.
english: one who rules his own house well, having children in subjection with all reverence;

paite: Mi'n ama insung vaihawm nangawn kizentak a ahihsiam keileh bangchi in ahia Pathian saptuam akep theih ding?
english: (for how could someone who doesn’t know how to rule his own house take care of God’s assembly?)

paite: Gingthakmi ahi ding ahi kei, huchi lou in zaw akisathei kha dia, diabol siam louh tansakna ah apuk kha ding hi.
english: not a new convert, lest being puffed up he fall into the same condemnation as the devil.

paite: Huaite lou leng polam a mite phat in a-om nalai ding ahi, huchi lou in zaw gensiat a a-om in diabol thang ah a-awk kha ding hi.
english: Moreover he must have good testimony from those who are outside, to avoid falling into reproach and the snare of the devil.

paite: Huchibang in Saptuam Upate leng mizahtakhuai ahih ding uh ahi; kamtamte, uain haite, lepna nin a huaiham mite ahi ding ahi kei;
heading: Saptuam Kemtu Upate
english: Servants, in the same way, must be reverent, not double-tongued, not addicted to much wine, not greedy for money,

paite: sia-le-pha theihna siang a ginna a thuguk kemmi ahi zaw ding uhi.
english: holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.

paite: Huan huaite leng chet in om masa uhen, huai nung in gensiatbei ahong hih uleh Saptuam Upa nna sem uhen.
english: Let them also first be tested; then let them serve if they are blameless.

paite: Huchibang in azite uh leng mizahtakhuai ahi ding uhi, gensiat hat lou, kidek thei leh bangkim a muanhuai ahi ding uhi.
english: Their wives in the same way must be reverent, not slanderers, temperate, and faithful in all things.

paite: Saptuam Upate zi khat nei atate uleh amau insung vaihawm navaktak a hihmi hi uhen.
english: Let servants be husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.

paite: Saptuam Upa nna hoihtak a semte'n amau a ding in phat tak hihna aloh ua, huan Khrist Jesu a om ginna a muanna leh hangsanna thupitak amu uhi.
english: For those who have served well gain for themselves a good standing and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.

paite: Sawt lou nung a na kiang a hong hoh lamen in hiai thu na kiang ah ka gelh ahi;
heading: Biakna Thuguk
english: These things I write to you, hoping to come to you shortly,

paite: himahleh ka hong zekai khakleh Pathian inkuanpihte lak a mi bangchibang in ahia a-om ding uh chih na theihna ding in ka gelh ahi; Pathian inkuanpihte Pathian hing saptuamte, thutak khuam leh kingakna ahi uhi.
english: but if I wait long, that you may know how men ought to behave themselves in God’s house, which is the assembly of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.

paite: Pathian limsakna thuguk nial vual louh in athupi hi: "Taksa a muh theih a latsak in Pathian a-om a, Kha a siamtansak, Angelte muh, namte lak a tangkoupih, khovel a mite gintak, thupina apitouh ahi."
english: Without controversy, the mystery of godliness is great: God was revealed in the flesh, justified in the spirit, seen by angels, preached among the nations, believed on in the world, and received up in glory.
